title: Wholesome Shakshuka
subtitle: with Yoghurt, Potato and Pepitas
description: A one-pan wonder indeed! Sweet capsicum, iron-rich silverbeet and soft potato are simmered in a rich tomato sauce. Simply nestle eggs within the mixture and gently cook until set.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Thinly slice the onion. Cut the capsicum into 2cm chunks. Peel the potato, then cut into 2cm chunks. Discard the tough inner stems from the silverbeet, then thinly slice the leaves. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves.

Pan-fry veggies: Put the pepitas in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat (see Make it faster). Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in the pan over medium heat. Cook the onion, capsicum, potato and garlic, stirring occasionally, for 6 mins or until the onion and capsicum are softened.

Simmer sauce: Add the silverbeet and stir for 2 mins or until wilted. Add the tomatoes and 100ml boiling water, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium, cover and cook for 12 mins. Cook, uncovered, for a further 5 mins or until the potatoes are tender and the sauce is slightly thickened. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Bake eggs: Make 2 egg-sized indents in the sauce and crack 2 eggs into the indents. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 4-5 mins until the eggs are just set or cooked to your liking. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Meanwhile, combine the yoghurt and 3 tsp water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Drizzle the baked eggs with the yoghurt and scatter over the pepitas. Divide among bowls and enjoy!
Make it faster: To save on time, you can toast the pepitas in a separate small frypan while you cook the vegetables.
